children: BrightSpire Capital reported third-quarter 2026 GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders of $46.9 million, or $0.37 per share. Distributable Earnings were $10.3 million, or $0.08 per share, and Adjusted Distributable Earnings were $17.8 million, or $0.14 per share. The company also reported GAAP net book value of $7.08 per share as of September 30.
GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders was $46.9 million, or $0.37 per share.
Distributable Earnings were $10.3 million, or $0.08 per share.
Adjusted Distributable Earnings were $17.8 million, or $0.14 per share.
As of September 30, 2026, GAAP net book value was $7.08 per share and undepreciated book value was $7.87 per share.
A quarterly dividend of $0.16 per share was paid on October 14 to common stockholders of record as of September 30.
Closed $272 million of committed loan originations during the quarter, with an additional $66 million closed or in execution after quarter-end.
Completed its fifth collateralized loan obligation, the second of 2026; CLO liabilities represented nearly two-thirds of loan portfolio financing.
Sold its largest asset, a portfolio of triple-net-lease distribution centers, and reported a reduction in real estate owned exposure.
The loan portfolio stood at approximately $3.1 billion, up more than 30% year over year, with an improved composition focused on middle-market borrowers.
